facts.text: Under the K-Plan, Kalamazoo College structures undergraduate education into a flexible four-part framework integrating individualized academics with off-campus experiential education, study abroad, and a required senior individualized project.

sources.title: K-Plan | Academics | Open Curriculum Colleges - Kalamazoo College
sources.quote: Your K-Plan is the four-part, personalized education journey you chart throughout your time at K. Rooted in excellent academics in the liberal arts and sciences, the K-Plan integrates your classroom learning with intercultural experiences, hands-on practice and independent scholarship.
